title: Pwnagotchi
summary: Pwnagotchi dashboard for an existing service and external USB Wi-Fi.
description: A safe, read-only APPLaunch companion UI for an existing, administrator-managed Pwnagotchi and bettercap installation. It shows status, nearby access points, clients, and handshakes. The package does not create, control, or replace system services; modify bettercap caplets; install Python packages; or write to /usr/local. A monitor-mode capable external USB Wi-Fi adapter is required; use only on networks and devices you own or are authorized to test.
